prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Company news: retail, restaurant, apparel, travel and leisure.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Every material company-specific news item for US-listed retail, restaurant, apparel, travel and leisure companies >= $1B in the window, as many as you can find: press releases, 8-K filings, executive changes, activist campaigns, legal settlements, contracts, product launches, guidance, analyst rating/PT changes (firm, old → new), and the stock move. One bullet per company.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **NKE** — Apparel
- Nike reported fiscal Q1 2027 EPS above consensus, but sales below consensus; management guided fiscal 2027 sales to a high-single-digit decline, with EBIT declining more than sales and EPS below the \$1.50 analyst expectation. Nike also announced a \$2.5 billion cost-savings program, approximately 5.5% of fiscal 2026 sales. The report said shares fell to their lowest level in 13 years in after-hours trading. (Investrade, Oct. 2, 2026; Oregon Live, Oct. 3, 2026)

## **ABNB** — Travel & Leisure
- KeyBanc upgraded Airbnb to **Overweight** from **Sector Weight** and assigned a \$191 price target. (Investrade, Oct. 2, 2026)

## **TNL** — Travel & Leisure
- Travel + Leisure Co. announced a new **Trail Partners** network for Eddie Bauer Adventure Club members; Under Canvas was identified as the first partner, providing access to all 18 of its North American properties. The company also said it will release third-quarter 2026 results before the market open on Oct. 27, followed by an 8:30 a.m. ET conference call. (Business Wire, Oct. 2, 2026)

## **RCL** — Travel & Leisure
- Citi removed Royal Caribbean Group from its “upside 90-day catalyst watch,” while maintaining a **Buy** rating and a \$362 price target. The stock was reported at \$2.40 higher in premarket trading on Oct. 2; the report cited a 17.23% one-week rally. (Yahoo Finance/TheFly, Oct. 2, 2026)
- Royal Caribbean expects its planned acquisition of Sandals to be accretive to earnings in 2027. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2, 2026)

## **CCL** — Travel & Leisure
- Carnival shares gained **15.8%** during the week after fiscal Q3 2026 results; revenue per available lower berth increased **2.4%** and customer deposits reached a record **\$7.6 billion**, up **\$500 million** year over year. Freedom Broker raised its price target to **\$36 from \$35** and maintained a **Buy** rating. (Yahoo Finance/Stocktwits, Oct. 5, 2026)

## **MAT** — Leisure
- Mattel shares gained **14.9%** during the week amid reported acquisition speculation. Authentic Brands Group had privately discussed a potential acquisition that could value Mattel above **\$20 per share**, implying a transaction value of at least **\$6 billion**. **[rumor] [report]** (Yahoo Finance/Stocktwits, Oct. 5, 2026)

## **SFIX** — Retail
- Mizuho upgraded Stitch Fix to **Neutral** from **Underperform** and reduced its price target to **\$2.50 from \$3.00**. Shares gained **21%** during the week. (Yahoo Finance/Stocktwits, Oct. 5, 2026)

## **FLUT** — Online Leisure
- Flutter Entertainment suspended its Brazilian business after Brazil implemented a ban on online sports betting; the company warned that an extended shutdown could reduce 2026 revenue by approximately **\$70 million**. Shares declined **10%** during the week. (Yahoo Finance/Stocktwits, Oct. 5, 2026)

## **ELF** — Retail
- E.l.f. Beauty released “Mirror Mix,” an original album featuring **seven** emerging artists, as part of an increased marketing program. The company said the additional marketing spending was funded in part by tariff refunds. (CNBC, Oct. 4, 2026)

## **GAP** — Apparel
- Gap announced a multiyear partnership with boy band **Just Your Type**, including a multi-episode docuseries, a national mall tour, and a clothing collection. (CNBC, Oct. 4, 2026)

## **WEN** — Restaurant
- Wendy’s released an emo album titled “Songs to Listen to in a Wendy’s Parking Lot” as part of a marketing campaign. (CNBC, Oct. 4, 2026)
